required_before_evidentiary_use: Retrieve the registered generation and activation bytes from the exact paths or an authenticated artifact export.
Hash every retrieved file and preserve an immutable retrieval receipt.
Validate prompt IDs, frame and tier labels, sample counts, decoding metadata, row uniqueness, missingness, judge fields, and exact joins against the recovered selection receipts.
Validate the activation archive keys, dimensions, prompt ordering, layer, pooling method, and source model revision before considering it for the frozen probe.
Keep summary pages and completion-checkpoint numbers classified as transcript-provenance pilot findings until the row-level bundles pass validation.
Do not reuse the historical three-sample rows as the prospective one-sample direct prompt-versus-SFT comparison.
